prose: The newest Disney/Marvel series, Secret Invasion, hits suspiciously close to the mark in its themes that mirror supposedly organic "real" events in recent mainstream media, and your favorite decoding crew is on the case. Shapeshifting doppelganger reptilians? Check. Cold War and nuclear panic pantomimes? Check! Get ready for another fascinating affirmation of your predictive programming suspicions as Slick Dissident and I let these cats out of the bag.
